m2-acceptance.purpose: M2's acceptance tests (campaign.md finish-line items 3 to 5), written before the tools exist. When M2 lands and they pass, delete this lane: they join the EndToEnd gate, and its floor and the baseline grow by this lane's count.

live-nami.purpose: Finish-line item 6's live check against the nami running on the Mac; run there while the sessions export to it. It has no CI job: no runner reaches that nami.
